verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents built-in AI for natural-language data work. Cortex Analyst lets users ask questions in natural language and get answers without writing SQL, grounded in schema-level semantic views. Cortex Code is described as an AI coding agent integrated into Snowflake. However, the evidence never shows the assistant explicitly writing visible SQL, fixing broken queries, or explaining SQL. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of SQL generation surfaced to the user in the editor, SQL error-fixing, SQL explanation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
